values.task_boundary: Issue completion is exactly one behavior-preserving resilience owner-boundary refactor; module extraction and test relocation are internal steps and line movement is not a separate result.
deliverables: One refactored resilience module family with explicit owner boundaries and a narrower change-validation surface.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Supported resilience behavior and public API remain compatible
AC-2: Each extracted module has one coherent owner
AC-3: Tests remain behavior-focused and PVF-classified
AC-4: Validation-impact change is measured exactly
AC-5: No line-count reduction quota is imposed
